description: This file defines functions related to resolving the enablement and configuration of native commands within a plugin-based system. It handles checking whether certain command features are enabled based on provider and global settings, and provides utility functions for command flag evaluation.

methods.name: export function resolveNativeCommandsEnabled(params: { resolveNativeCommandsEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether native commands are enabled for a given provider, considering provider and global settings.

methods.description: Core function that determines the effective setting for native commands or skills based on provider and global preferences.

methods.description: Determines if native commands are explicitly disabled by settings.
